title: The Broken Choir
author: Ada Yarrow
blurb: Yara Eriksen, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
